control_profile: Own-history activity normalization, cross-sectional residualization, ten-percent damping of unconfirmed positive scores, thirty-five-percent damping of unconfirmed negative scores, rank retention, and central risk controls.
falsifier: Stronger long-side price confirmation fails to make at least four base and doubled-cost folds positive, damages the profitable short sleeve, or pushes gross edge below fifty basis points per turnover.
formation_horizon: 168 completed 8-hour bars with an 18-bar pressure window
hypothesis: More aggressively damping positive flow scores when price disagrees should remove stale or distributive longs while preserving the baseline short-pressure hedge and aggregate edge.
